Commentary.Commentary: Morris feels pretty good about restricting Pakistan to this total. Reckons they got away in the end but they would have taken this total at the beginning. Believes that the visitors are number 1 in the world in T20Is for a reason and thus, they can never rule them out and knows that the hosts have to be constantly on the money. In the end, he leaves by saying that it is not an easy ground to defend scores and that they (South Africa) should win if they bat well.

South Africa won't be too unhappy with the score because it is a chaseable one. After going for runs in the Powerplay, they fought their way back in. Beuran Hendricks stood out with his career best of 4/14. Morris picked up a brace while Sipamla and Phehlukwayo got a wicket each but went for runs. So, South Africa have a great chance to clean sweep Pakistan if they bat well. Join us in a bit for the chase. Meanwhile, Chris Morris is down for an interview.

A fighting total from Pakistan. After losing their way, Shadab has ensured they have something on the board. The visitors started well when Babar and Fakhar gave them a head-start. Once that partnership broke, they kept losing wickets at regular intervals. The tourists needed someone to bat through but that didn't happen. Thanks to Asif and Shadab but mainly the latter at the end, the Men in Green get near the 170-run mark.

SIX! Good way to finish the innings. Amazing shot from Shadab Khan. Short of a length delivery, Khan pulls it between mid-wicket and deep square leg for a biggie. Big over for Pakistan. 21 runs have come from it. The visitors would have got momentum with this and will believe the score is a fighting one now. SOUTH AFRICA WILL NEED 169 TO WIN.
Length delivery on off, Khan looks to defend but gets a bottom edge on this one.
WIDE! Bowls down the leg side, Khan looks to play a paddle sweep but misses it because it is out of reach for him.
SIX! Second six of the over. Length delivery outside off, Shadab lofts this over long off for a biggie. This over is proving to be expensive.
Full on middle, Khan drives it towards mid on for a single.
SIX! What a cracking shot! Full on off, Shadab lofts this over extra cover for a biggie. Much needed one for Pakistan.
Length delivery on middle, Khan plays it over the bowler towards mid off.
Andile Phehlukwayo will bowl the final over.
Length ball in line of the stumps. Afridi blocks it out. Hendricks finishes with career best figures of 4-0-14-4 after conceding just 2 runs off the 19th over.
Bouncer! Follows Afridi, who ducks under it.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Shaheen Afridi is the last man to the crease.

OUT! Finds the man again. Poor cricket from Amir. Just had to take the single to give Shadab the strike but goes for the big one and gets out first ball. Fuller ball around off, Amir slices it over but finds Rassen at deep point. He doesn't drop those and Pakistan lose their 9th wicket. They're in a danger of not facing the entire 20 overs here.
Outside off, guided towards third man for one.
The new man in is Mohammad Amir.

OUT! Soft dismissal and not good cricket. Fuller ball on middle. Faheem gives room and looks to loft it over the rope. Doesn't hit that with power and ends up chipping it to Miller at long on who takes a simple catch.
Beuran Hendricks to bowl the penultimate over.
Length delivery on off, Ashraf cuts it towards point for a single. Morris finishes with figures of 4-0-27-2.
Shadab Khan is the new man in.

OUT! Asif Ali departs! Crucial wicket for South Africa. Full on off, Ali goes for the big shot but does not get enough on it. The ball goes towards cover point fielder where Rassie van der Dussen takes a good catch under lights. The visitors are seven down and are losing their way.
Length delivery on off, Ashraf cuts it towards point for a single. The fielder at deep point fumbles but the batsmen decide against the second.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Ashraf looks to slog but misses it.
Length delivery on middle, Ali flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
SIX! HAMMERED IT AWAY! Full on middle, overpitched, in his zone. Ali lofts this over mid-wicket for a biggie. Good start to the 18th over.
Chris Morris to bowl the 18th over.
Short delivery, Asif pulls it over mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Ashraf flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Full outside off, Ali plays it over mid off. The batsmen take a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Ali looks to go for the slog but misses it.
Short delivery, Ashraf pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on off, Ali plays it towards covers for a single.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Ali lets it go.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Asif looks to cut but it was wide of him.
Faheem Ashraf is next to bat. Also, Andile Phehlukwayo to bowl another over.

OUT! Bowled 'em! This shows what couple of singles and a dot ball can do. Off cutter on off, Imam goes across and looks to play at the wrong line. Doesn't read the cutter and misses it completely. The ball goes on to disturb the off pole.
Yorker outside off, Imad gives room and does well to get bat on it but only back to the bowler.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, Asif plays an on-drive to long on for one.
Slower bouncer on the leg side. Wasim waits for it and then looks to pull but gets his off his gloves. The ball rolls towards the on side where they cross.
FOUR! That's some strike. A fraction short on off, Imad gives room and smacks this over mid-wicket for a clean hit. It bounces before the ropes.
Comes in from around the wicket and serves this on the leg side. Asif tucks it around the corner for one.
Beuran Hendricks is in for another spell.
On middle and leg, Ali nudges it towards square leg for a single. Decent over for Pakistan. 11 runs came from it.

Length delivery on off, Wasim plays it with soft hands to the side of the pitch on the offside and goes for a run. Morris runs to the ball quickly, collects it with one hand and goes for a direct hit at the keeper's end but misses it. Asif Ali was a goner had he hit the stumps. Very lucky there Pakistan!
Length delivery on middle, Wasim works it towards the leg side.

FOUR! This was even better. Full on middle, Wasim makes room, swings and hits it straight over the bowler for a boundary. Bit of a heated argument between Morris and Imad Wasim post that shot on the middle of the 22 yards.
FOUR! What a shot. Length delivery on off, Wasim comes down the track and drives it through covers for a boundary. It was a full toss which was put away by the batsman.
Length delivery on off, Asif looks to go big but gets a top edge. The fielder from third man and the keeper both went for the catch. It falls in no man's land. The batsmen take a run.
Chris Morris is into the attack.
Outside off again, Asif gets it past backward point for one. Shamsi has finished his quota, 4-0-30-0.
Googly outside off, Ali looks to cut it away but fails to make contact.
Steers this to the on side to rotate strike.
Punched off the back foot by Ali towards covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! Way back into the grandstand! Overpitched ball on off, Asif Ali steps out and smokes this away over long on for a monster hit.
Leg spinner on the pads, flicked away through square leg for one.
Length delivery on off, Wasim plays it towards point for a single. Another good over for the hosts.
100 up for Pakistan. Length delivery on middle, Asif flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Bowls a bumper, Ali does well to duck under it. Umpire gives it as a wide because it was way over the head of the batsman.
WIDE! Short of a length delivery down leg, Ali looks to pull but misses it.
Length delivery on middle, Wasim works it towards square leg for a single.
Again on a length, Ali pushes it towards square leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Wasim flicks it to the leg side for a run.
The new man in is Imad Wasim.

OUT! Pakistan have pressed the panic button. Good length delivery on off, Talat makes room and looks to cut but Andile follows the southpaw. He lacks the room and thus, gets an outside edge which goes towards Klaasen who takes a comfortable catch. Half of the visitors' side is back in the hut now.
Andile Phehlukwayo is back.
Flighted delivery on middle, Ali defends off the back foot.
Bowls googly on off, Asif looks to cut but gets beaten on this one.
Floated on middle, Talat nudges it towards square leg for a single.
On the pads, Ali flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Asif Ali replaces Shoaib Malik.

OUT! It is Shoaib Malik who is run out. This was suicidal from the visitors. Floated on leg, Malik pushes it to the leg side. Talat calls for the single and Malik responds. Hussain slipped while he was halfway down the wicket and turns his back on his partner. Shoaib gets caught in the middle of nowhere and Andile Phehlukwayo throws the ball calmly to Klaasen who whips the bails off. No way for the Pak skipper to get back. Both got stuck almost parellel to each other and hence the confusion regarding who was out. After many replays, it is the experienced Malik who has to make the long walk back. Big blow for the visitors.
Now then! Someone is out but we don't know who. It was a run out but we are waiting to see if Malik crossed past Talat when the bails were taken off.
Floated on middle, Talat works it towards the leg side for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Malik taps this through the off side and gets to the other end.
Hussain Talat walks in next.

OUT! First wicket for Sipamla! Length ball outside off, Rizwan goes after it. Looks to cut it over cover-point but doesn't get the distance on it. Dala at the ropes takes an easy catch. Sipamla is delighted and South Africa get a timely breakthrough.

FOUR! Miscommunication and a boundary to Pakistan. Full ball on the pads, Rizwan flicks it away through square leg. The fielder from fine leg and square leg run in to stop the ball but it goes through them. Boundary.
NOT OUT! Fuller ball on off, Rizwan creams it through covers and takes on the fielder in the deep. In the end they complete the second.
Run out appeal! Rizwan is the man in question but looks to have made it.
Better from Sipamla. On a good length around off, Rizwan drives it to covers.
Lutho Sipamla is back.
Flighted delivery on off, the captain keeps it out. 83 runs have come in 10 overs. Pakistan are going at a fair clip.
Loopy delivery on middle, Rizwan sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, the skipper nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Mohammad flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Malik comes down the track and hits it straight through mid on. The batsmen cross ends.
Floated on off, Rizwan comes down the track and plays it towards covers for a run.
Outside off, Malik taps it to point. Even after a couple of misses, they get 10 from the over.
FOUR! Second boundary for Malik in the over. This one is fuller on off, Malik gets it off the sweet spot through covers for a boundary.
Play and miss. This one keeps low. Outside off, Malik looks to play it with a straight bat but cannot help himself.
FOUR! SHOT! Gives Shoaib width outside off, his eyes lit up and he slaps this through point for a boundary.
BEAUTY! Good length ball around off. The ball moves in the air. Malik feels for it but cannot make any contact.
WIDE! Length ball way outside off, Mailk swings but misses. The umpire gives it as wide.
Driven through the covers by Rizwan. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Junior Dala is back.
Flighted delivery on middle, Rizwan nudges it towards the leg side for a single. Big over for Pakistan. 12 runs came from it.
Floated on middle, Malik flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Full on off, Mohammad drives it towards covers for a run.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Rizwan. This was even better. Tossed up on middle and leg, Rizwan sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. He plays it along the ground.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Floated on middle, Rizwan plays a sweep over backward square leg. The ball goes on one bounce into the ropes.
Flighted delivery on middle, Malik flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack.
Length delivery on off, Malik taps it towards point for a single. That is six singles off the over.
Full on middle, Rizwan punches it towards mid on for a single.
Short outside off, Malik cuts it towards point for a single.
Full on middle, Rizwan drives it towards mid on for a single.
Short outside off, Malik cuts it through point for a single.
Length ball outside off, Rizwan opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo to bowl his first over.
Fuller ball on the pads, Malik flicks it to cow corner and comes back for the second. The 50 is up for Pakistan at the end of the Powerplay.
Back of a length ball around off, Rizwan guides it to third man to get off strike.
Shoaib Malik is the new man in.

OUT! South Africa get the second breakthrough. Just before the end of the Powerplay, the hosts get another wicket. Fuller length delivery outside off, angled away from Fakhar. He comes down the track and looks to swing it big but gets a top edge which flies towards third man. Tabraiz Shamsi comes from his right, dives forward and takes a wonderful diving catch. The southpaw was looking to make the most of the Powerplay but holes out.
Full on middle, Zaman drives it towards mid on.
Length delivery on off, Rizwan defends it and takes a quick single.
Good length delivery on off, Rizwan defends off the back foot.
Beuran Hendricks to bowl his second over.
Outside off, Zaman looks to drive but gets beaten on this one. What an over, just what SA would have wanted. Just one run off it in the end.
Length delivery on middle, Zaman pulls it to fine leg.
Short outside off, Zaman cuts it to point.
Full on leg, Zaman flicks it to short fine leg.
Length delivery on middle, Rizwan pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single. The fielder goes for the direct hit but misses it.
Good length delivery on off, Rizwan plays it back to the bowler.
Darts this on the pads of Zaman who flicks it away through square leg. Reeza runs and stops it at the ropes keeping it to two. 21 runs from Sipamla's first over.
FOUR Leg byes! Oh dear! Nothing is going right for Sipamla. Bowls another one down the leg side. Zaman flicks it but it goes off his thigh pad, fine and into the fine leg boundary. 19 runs already.
FOUR! Pakistan are off to a flier. Another ball banged in short. Zaman stands tall and just pulls it through square leg this time. Boundary.
Wide! Bangs it short way down leg. The umpire signals a wide.
SIX! Nice pick up shot. Short ball on the leg side. Fakhar goes after it and pulls it over square leg. It comes off the toe end but still travels over the square leg boundary.
Better from Sipamla. Closer to the stumps, Zaman blocks it.
FOUR! Not the best of starts. Errs one down the leg side on the hips of Fakhar who just helps it on its way towards fine leg. No one there and the southpaw gets himself a boundary.
Lutho Sipamla to bowl his first.
Full on off, Rizwan drives it to covers. A successful over for the hosts, 6 runs and a wicket off it.
Length delivery on off, Rizwan plays it to point.
Mohammad Rizwan earns himself a promotion to no. 3.

OUT! Babar departs! Chris Morris was brought into the attack and he strikes! What a wicket for South Africa. Huge. This one was a bit wide outside off, Babar went after it but was a bit off balance. Ends up giving it to Malan at cover-point who moves to his right and takes a good catch. Azam was looking good but has to walk back now.
Length delivery on middle, Zaman pushes it to the leg side for a single.
Length delivery on off, Azam guides it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Length delivery outside off, Babar looks to cut but gets an outside edge wide of first slip. The ball races away to the fence.
Chris Morris is the first change.
Short delivery, Azam pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single. Big over for Pakistan. 17 runs came from it.
FOUR! This over is proving to be too expensive. Short of a length delivery, Azam plays an upper cut over the slips for a boundary. Four fours off the over so far with a ball to go.
FOUR! Good shot again. Full on middle, Babar flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Third boundary of the over. Exciting stuff.
Good length delivery on off, Azam defends off the back foot.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Babar Azam. Short outside off, Azam cuts it through point for a boundary. No stopping that!
FOUR! Amazing shot. Short of a length delivery, Babar pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Junior Dala to bowl from the other end.
Great start from Beuran. Gets the ball to move away a bit around off on a good length. Fakhar looks to play it to the off side but is beaten all ends up. Just the 1 run from the over.
Change of length again. This one is on a good length around off. Fakhar guides it towards point. Dot ball.
Pitched this up further, angled into the batsman who hits it back to the bowler.
Runs in from over the wicket for Fakhar. Darts this again on the body of Zaman who misses his flick.
Quick single. Pakistan are away. Back of a length ball on the body. Babar tucks it away towards mid on and completes the run.
Great start. Comes in from around the wicket and lands it on a good length outside off. Babar looks to go for the drive first up but misses it.
We are good to go! The players and the umpires make their way out. Babar Azam and Fakhar Zaman will open for the visitors. Beuran Hendricks to bowl the first ball.

TEAM NEWS - South Africa are unchanged from the previous game. Pakistan have two changes to the team that played the second T20I, with Mohammad Amir and Faheem Ashraf replacing the duo of Usman Khan and Hasan Ali.
TOSS - South Africa won the toss and elected to bowl first.

Welcome to the final T20I of this three-match series between South Africa and Pakistan. The Proteas have sealed the series 2-0 and this game is a dead rubber. But that said, do not expect any pleasantries to be served by the hosts. They will look to whitewash the visitors 3-0. David Miller, the captain has been doing well winning both the matches as well as the Man of the Match award in both games. This must have given him lot of confidence, and the series being done already gives him an opportunity to give the bench a go. On the other hand, Pakistan will look to get a consolation victory to end what has been a disappointing tour. Changes are likely to be there for the visitors as well. Toss and team news to follow...
